probe_window: live postfiatd testnet (network 2025) vs l1v2 specification at rev 071b6dc461efc7a9105b2d3cac6acd3686901e7d

scenarios.title: Quorum arithmetic at the live UNL size (n=25)
scenarios.detail: At n=25 both formulas give 17, matching the reported quorum. The agreement is arithmetic coincidence at this n, not a shared rule.

scenarios.title: Quorum arithmetic at n=103 (first divergence)
scenarios.detail: postfiatd ceil(0.67*103)=70; l1v2 floor(2*103/3)+1=69. The two quorum rules are different functions and diverge once n exceeds 100 with n = 1 mod 3.

scenarios.title: Quorum at the l1v2 launch minimum (n=12)
scenarios.detail: At n=12: postfiatd 9, l1v2 consensus 9, l1v2 genesis ratification 10. Three different quorum values govern three different phases.

scenarios.title: Ledger close cadence within postfiatd bounds; no l1v2 cadence

l1v2_expected.note: No block time, slot duration, or ledger-close cadence is specified in the pinned l1v2 docs or code surveyed; the devnet makes blocks only when transactions are pending

scenarios.detail: Measured mean close interval 3.046 s is inside the postfiatd bounds (2 s min close, 15 s idle), but l1v2 specifies no cadence at all, so there is nothing to compare it against. UNVERIFIED, not inferred.

scenarios.title: Ledger close-time resolution

l1v2_expected.note: l1v2 specifies no close-time resolution; Consensus v2 progress is view/timeout driven

scenarios.detail: Live ledger close_time_resolution is 10 s (postfiatd genesis resolution 10 s, default 30 s). l1v2 defines no close-time resolution, so no comparison is possible.

scenarios.title: Last-close converge time vs postfiatd max consensus

l1v2_expected.note: l1v2 specifies no converge-time bound; view changes are timeout-certificate driven

scenarios.detail: Last close converged in 2001 ms with 24 proposers, inside the postfiatd 15 s max-consensus bound. No l1v2 bound exists to compare.

scenarios.title: Amendment majority threshold

l1v2_expected.general_amendment_mechanism: GovernanceAmendment object (crates/types/src/shielded_bridge_governance.rs:2011-2034) with quorum, support, activation_height, veto_until_height fields; activation is per-kind and height-based (latest committed wins for fee/memo gates; earliest unpaused height wins for recipient format); no single global majority threshold and no time-based supermajority rule exists
l1v2_expected.governed_lane_threshold: registry threshold floor(2n/3)+1 of the active validator set
l1v2_expected.note: l1v2 has a GovernanceAmendment object, but no single global majority threshold: each amendment carries its own quorum/support and activates per-kind at a height

scenarios.detail: postfiatd activates amendments by validator vote at a uniform 67%% majority (fix active on the live network). l1v2 has a GovernanceAmendment object, but its threshold is per-amendment (quorum/support fields) with per-kind height-based activation — there is no uniform validator-vote threshold to compare against. The only precisely specified l1v2 threshold is the registry threshold floor(2n/3)+1 for lane amendments.

scenarios.title: Amendment majority hold time

l1v2_expected.governed_amendment_timing: activation_height of the proposal slot; cap raises apply 7 windows after commit
l1v2_expected.veto_procedure: No veto procedure is specified beyond the veto_until_height field on the amendment object

scenarios.detail: postfiatd holds an amendment majority for 3 days on this testnet (2-week code default) before activation. l1v2 governed lane amendments apply at a named activation height, with cap raises delayed 7 windows — a different timing model with no majority-hold period — and no veto procedure is specified beyond the veto_until_height field.

scenarios.title: Genesis supply reconciliation

l1v2_expected.l1v2_supply_note: Total supply 100B PFT fixed (decided 2026-10-28); the ERC-20 slice size is open; genesis gives the faucet the native supply minus the lanes' reserved_atoms
l1v2_expected.note: The ERC-20 slice size is open and no l1v2 network exists to measure; the faucet-minus-lanes model cannot be reconciled against a live ledger

scenarios.detail: Live postfiatd reconciliation closes exactly at 100B PFT. l1v2 specifies the same 100B total but splits it into a faucet plus reserved lane atoms with an open slice size, on no live network — so the l1v2 side cannot be verified.

scenarios.title: Genesis construction model

postfiatd_measured.model: Ledger::Ledger(create_genesis_t): seq 1, whole 100B supply in one account

l1v2_expected.model: G0 = Selected intersect Receipted from a frozen Dynamic UNL round on the fork; ML-DSA-65 identity receipts; domain-separated SHA-256 payload hash; certificate of >= q_S signatures

scenarios.detail: postfiatd genesis is a single-account fresh ledger; l1v2 genesis is a ratified validator registry with an identity bridge. The two constructions share nothing except the 100B supply figure.

scenarios.title: Validation / vote lifetimes

l1v2_expected.note: No wall-clock validity window is specified; votes persist under the durable round floor until superseded by a higher round (docs/architecture/consensus-signing-rounds.md)

scenarios.detail: postfiatd validations expire after minutes (5 min wall, 3 min local). l1v2 votes carry no wall-clock lifetime; they persist under the durable round floor until superseded. Replay/retention across the boundary is undefined.

scenarios.title: Commit rule

postfiatd_measured.model: A ledger is validated when trusted validations on one ledger hash reach the validation quorum (17 of UNL 25 live)

l1v2_expected.model: q distinct precommit votes for the same non-nil block form the only commit QC; a prepare QC of q votes is the durable lock

scenarios.detail: One validation message per validator per ledger (postfiatd) vs two QC phases with durable locks and timeout-certificate view changes (l1v2). A ledger validated under one rule is not validated under the other.

scenarios.title: Validator identity and key type

postfiatd_measured.model: secp256k1 validator keys, manifests, publisher-served validator list (VL v2)

l1v2_expected.model: ML-DSA-65 validator keys, bridged from fork secp256k1 keys by dual-signed identity receipts

scenarios.detail: No postfiatd validator key can sign an l1v2 vote without the identity-bridge receipt; no l1v2 ML-DSA key can sign a postfiatd validation.

scenarios.title: External audit recorded

postfiatd_measured.note: No audit is recorded for postfiatd; the founder's multi-million-dollar audit is a statement, not a scoped engagement

scenarios.detail: Neither codebase has a recorded external audit. There is no independent verification of either consensus implementation to compare.

scenarios.title: Mainnet / TGE date published

postfiatd_measured.note: No official mainnet/TGE date is published in the surveyed sources

l1v2_expected.note: No official mainnet/TGE date is published in the surveyed sources; the word TGE does not appear in docs/, README.md or roadmap.md

scenarios.detail: No mainnet date exists on either side; there is no schedule to compare and no convergence date to assess.
